title: Tencent Hy Memory 2.0 Beats Opus 5 on 4 AI Memory Benchmarks
summary:
Tencent has launched an open source software suite for AI agents to manage how they store and recall conversational data. The system, called Hy Memory 2.0, features the Hy-Memory-30B-A3B model, which utilizes a Mixture of Experts architecture with 30B total parameters and 3B active parameters. This model ranks first among open source alternatives on four benchmarks and outperforms Opus 5 in memory processing tasks.

The software is released under the Apache 2.0 license and includes MemHub, a tool for Mac and command line interfaces that syncs memory across more than 10 AI tools. The underlying framework is designed to handle memories for chat, work, and code, and it automatically extracts essential information from conversations and purges outdated data to maintain accuracy.
